text: MimeClosure stores a type and raw pointer, copies both, and defines an explicit bool conversion that checks only pointer presence. It has no ownership transfer or destructor cleanup in this class. A truthy closure still needs the appropriate checked conversion; its pointee must remain valid under the surrounding lifecycle. Preserve the explicit conversion so it cannot silently serve as an integer or pointer. Existing draft cleanup remains separate.
title: Do not mistake a truthy MimeClosure for a verified type or owner
